title: glosa readiness report
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Backs the kernel's `validate_readiness` function (FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §9) and `templates/readiness_report.md` (REPO_SPEC_v0.5.md). A pre-work, fail-closed self-check that a session is actually ready to start work in a glosa project (doc-ecosystem / project-onboard pattern applied to glosa itself): an overview of the work about to start, which methodology cards/skills were actually read, and a typed blockers/negatives/positives list -- distinct from problem_card.readiness, which is S1's own narrower two-question-intake self-check. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

scope.description: What work is about to start.

cards_read.description: methodology/ protocol cards, skills, or FOUNDATION sections actually read before this report -- not merely referenced.

allOf.description: Fail-closed: an unresolved blocker forbids a READY verdict.
